summary: Fifth session of test fixes for the whole PRD. It took the five Weak rows. AC-FIND-03 (8 of 8), AC-FIND-04 (11 of 11), AC-FIND-05 (2 of 2) and AC-FOLDER-02 (5 of 5) rose to Adequate, and fresh reviewers confirmed each grade. AC-SEE-04 rose from 6 of 7 to 11 of 13 but stays Weak. The settings rows and the field-message and unpickable-checkout styles are now compared in Chrome. A reviewer found that the settings' no-Change check can't fail with the rows it uses, and that the engine's split of the Located line is never pinned; both fixes are recorded in test-audit.md. Each new test was seen to fail with the behaviour broken. The unit suite (1239 tests) is green. The full integration suite never finished on a machine loaded by other sessions' suites: two runs timed out, and a third had passed 48 tests with no failure when it was stopped. Every integration and view file this session changed passes in full (56 and 24 tests). Only test files changed. AC-SEE-04 is left for the next session, and AC-ASK-06 stays stuck.

needsYou.problem: AC-ASK-06's test row is stuck at Weak after two attempts. No test runs kiln status against a running Kiln and checks that it reports locate-repository as unavailable, with the engine's own reason, when no stop is asking or before Start.
needsYou.action: Say how to proceed: approve the fix recorded in test-audit.md (two assertions in src/kiln-run-ask-after-start.integration.test.ts), or accept the row as it is.
